turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi! How are you doing these days?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My partner and I want to rent a campervan for a week in the mountains. Is that a silly idea if we've never driven one?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Not silly at all, lots of people do it. Smaller vans drive a lot like a big car. The main things are the height and the width.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Bridges, car parks, drive throughs, low branches. Write the height on a sticky note on the dashboard so you don't forget.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Ha, okay. What about mountain roads?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Use lower gears going downhill so you don't overheat the brakes, and pull into passing places to let faster cars by.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Wait, what was the last part?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Sure, here it is again. Use lower gears going downhill so you don't overheat the brakes, and pull into passing places to let faster cars by.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: It can be, but add up rental, fuel and campsite fees. It's often about the same, you're really paying for the freedom.
